Classic White Russian
By: Ben Myhre
Published: Friday, October 5, 2018 - 10:15am

Ingredients




1 Ounce Vodka
1 Ounce Kahlua
1 Ounce Heavy cream

Preparation

1 Add ice to Lowball Glass 2 Add Vodka & Kahlua to glass 3 Stir 4 Layer Heavy Cream on Top 5 Serve

About

Easy White Russian Recipe! This Kahlua drink is so tasty and I will show you how to make this classic vodka cocktail. All you need is a few simple ingredients to make this great drink. If you have vodka in your liquor cabinet, you are off to a good start. The other two ingredients you will need is Kahlua (or coffee liquor) and cream. Just a simple mix between them and you will have a beautiful cocktail!
